title: Number Of Self Divisible Permutations
statement:
A permutation `a` of `[1, 2, ..., n]` is self-divisible when `gcd(a[i], i) == 1` at every 1-indexed position `i`. Return the number of self-divisible permutations.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: n = 2
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: n = 3
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 12`
